Apple ships Managed Apple ID as an organization-issued Apple account created through Apple School Manager or Apple Business Manager. Managed Apple ID–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Org-identity marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Managed Apple ID — not a literal paste of US marketing:

托管 Apple ID (Managed Apple ID)

Apple's Chinese education and enterprise support materials use 托管 Apple ID for the organization-issued Apple account created through Apple School Manager or Apple Business Manager. Some MDM and education marketing also uses 管理式 Apple ID when emphasizing IT-controlled account management. AppLocale picks the term buyers recognize on each screenshot — a sign-in screen needs 托管 Apple ID-friendly phrasing; a benefit headline may use 管理式 Apple ID when accurate to your English source.

组织 Apple ID (organization Apple ID)

US pages use "Organization Apple ID" or "Org Apple ID for students and employees." China storefront copy often uses 组织 Apple ID or 企业 Apple ID when describing the org-issued account separate from personal consumer Apple IDs — enabling IT-controlled app access and shared resources without mixing personal iCloud data. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope, not inventing account-provisioning claims your app does not support.

Education apps marketing Apple School Manager integration use Apple School Manager 托管账号 or ASM 托管 Apple ID on frames that explain why school districts issue managed accounts for students and teachers — not as a promise that your app configures ASM portals or creates org accounts.

Enterprise and MDM apps marketing Apple Business Manager integration use Apple Business Manager 组织账号 or ABM 托管身份 on frames that explain org-issued employee accounts — not as a promise that your app provisions ABM Managed Apple ID accounts at runtime.
